import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

OPENCODE_MODEL = "opencode/deepseek-v4-flash-free"
REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
RALPH_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "ralph"
TASKS_FILE = RALPH_DIR / "tasks.md"
PROGRESS_FILE = RALPH_DIR / "progress.md"
LOGS_DIR = RALPH_DIR / "logs"
DONE_SENTINEL = "RALPH_DONE"
MAX_ITERATIONS = 500
RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS = 600.0
INCOMPLETE_TASK_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^\s*[-*]\s*\[ \]", re.MULTILINE)
RATE_LIMIT_PATTERN = re.compile(r"rate.?limit|429|too many requests|quota", re.IGNORECASE)


def build_plan_prompt(goal: str) -> str:
    return (
        "You are the planning step of a Ralph loop in this repository. "
        f"The overall goal is: {goal}\n\n"
        "Read AGENTS.md and journal.md first. Then create the file ralph/tasks.md "
        "containing a markdown checklist that breaks this goal into many small, "
        "independently completable mini tasks. Use exactly this line format for "
        "each task:\n"
        "- [ ] short title — one to three sentence description of exactly what to "
        "do and how to verify it\n\n"
        "Order tasks so earlier ones unblock later ones. Each task must be small "
        "enough to finish in a single short session. Do not implement anything "
        "yet, do not check any boxes, and do not create any other files. "
        f"Also create ralph/progress.md containing only the heading '# Ralph progress: {goal}'."
    )


def build_loop_prompt(goal: str) -> str:
    return (
        "You are one iteration of a Ralph loop in this repository. The overall "
        f"goal is: {goal}\n\n"
        "Read AGENTS.md, then ralph/tasks.md and ralph/progress.md. Pick exactly "
        "one unchecked task (- [ ]) from ralph/tasks.md — the earliest one whose "
        "prerequisites are met. Complete that one task fully, following all rules "
        "in AGENTS.md, including tests and commits. Then mark its checkbox as "
        "- [x] in ralph/tasks.md and append a dated entry to ralph/progress.md "
        "describing what you did, what worked, and what failed. Do not start a "
        "second task.\n\n"
        "If every task in ralph/tasks.md is already checked and the goal is "
        f"verifiably complete, change nothing and reply with exactly {DONE_SENTINEL}."
    )


def count_incomplete_tasks(tasks_markdown: str) -> int:
    return len(INCOMPLETE_TASK_PATTERN.findall(tasks_markdown))


def output_signals_done(output: str) -> bool:
    return DONE_SENTINEL in output


def looks_rate_limited(output: str) -> bool:
    return bool(RATE_LIMIT_PATTERN.search(output))


def run_opencode(prompt: str) -> tuple[int, str]:
    process = subprocess.run(
        ["opencode", "run", "--model", OPENCODE_MODEL, prompt],
        cwd=REPO_ROOT,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    return process.returncode, process.stdout + process.stderr


def write_log(name: str, output: str) -> None:
    LOGS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (LOGS_DIR / f"{name}.log").write_text(output)


def read_goal() -> str:
    goal = input("What goal do you want done? ").strip()
    if not goal:
        raise SystemExit("error: goal must not be empty")
    return goal


def plan_tasks(goal: str) -> None:
    print(f"planning: asking {OPENCODE_MODEL} to break the goal into mini tasks")
    for attempt in range(1, 4):
        returncode, output = run_opencode(build_plan_prompt(goal))
        write_log(f"plan_attempt_{attempt}", output)
        if returncode == 0 and TASKS_FILE.is_file() and count_incomplete_tasks(TASKS_FILE.read_text()) > 0:
            print(f"plan ready: {count_incomplete_tasks(TASKS_FILE.read_text())} tasks in {TASKS_FILE}")
            return
        print(f"planning attempt {attempt} failed (exit {returncode}); see ralph/logs/plan_attempt_{attempt}.log")
        time.sleep(30.0 * attempt)
    raise SystemExit("error: planning failed three times; inspect ralph/logs/ and rerun")


def handle_failed_iteration(iteration: int, returncode: int, output: str) -> None:
    if looks_rate_limited(output):
        print(f"iteration {iteration}: rate limited (opencode normally waits this out itself); retrying in {RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS / 60:.0f} minutes")
    else:
        print(f"iteration {iteration}: opencode exited {returncode}; retrying in {RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS / 60:.0f} minutes (see ralph/logs/)")
    time.sleep(RETRY_DELAY_SECONDS)


def ralph_loop(goal: str) -> None:
    prompt = build_loop_prompt(goal)
    for iteration in range(1, MAX_ITERATIONS + 1):
        remaining = count_incomplete_tasks(TASKS_FILE.read_text())
        if remaining == 0:
            print("all tasks checked off — ralph loop complete")
            return
        print(f"iteration {iteration}: {remaining} tasks remaining")
        returncode, output = run_opencode(prompt)
        write_log(f"iteration_{iteration:04d}", output)
        if returncode != 0:
            handle_failed_iteration(iteration, returncode, output)
            continue
        if output_signals_done(output) and count_incomplete_tasks(TASKS_FILE.read_text()) == 0:
            print(f"agent reported {DONE_SENTINEL} — ralph loop complete")
            return
    raise SystemExit(f"error: hit {MAX_ITERATIONS} iterations without finishing; inspect ralph/ and rerun")


def main() -> None:
    goal = read_goal()
    RALPH_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    if TASKS_FILE.is_file() and count_incomplete_tasks(TASKS_FILE.read_text()) > 0:
        print(f"existing plan found with {count_incomplete_tasks(TASKS_FILE.read_text())} open tasks — resuming it")
    else:
        plan_tasks(goal)
    ralph_loop(goal)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
